mode.description: off disables every AI call; ask confirms over the budget threshold; auto runs within caps.

profile.description: Key of the active profile in ai.profiles.

agent.description: CLI that runs agent work for this profile (default omp).

extra_headers.description: Headers sent on every request of an HTTP driver, e.g. a gateway's team or tag headers.

models.description: Role (explain, classify, draft, plan, implement, review) to model id. A missing classify model falls back to explain; a missing review model to draft, then explain.

prices.description: Model id to list prices in USD per million tokens, for pre-flight estimates.

timeout.description: Per-request timeout of an HTTP driver, e.g. "90s" (default 5m).

profiles.description: Places AI calls can go: a driver plus the models its roles use.

call_usd.description: Hard cap per call; also passed to omp as --max-cost.

daily_usd.description: Daily local spend cap; 0 is no cap.

sprint_usd.description: Sprint cap, enforced while a sprint window is known; 0 is no cap.

weekly_usd.description: Weekly local spend cap; 0 is no cap.

branch.description: Branch of the overriding repo (default: the repository's default branch).

enabled.description: Apply project dotfiles on this machine (default true). false turns them off for every project.

repo.description: Use this git URL instead of the dotfiles repo a project's manifest names. Has no effect on projects without [dotfiles].

ca_file.description: PEM bundle of the certificate authority a self-hosted forge uses; trusted for API and https git. SSL_CERT_FILE is honoured too.

max_concurrency.description: Most API requests in flight to this forge at once (default 4).

read_token_cmd.description: Command whose stdout is a read-only token (GitLab read_api, read_user, read_repository). With a read token, reads use it and only writes use the token.

read_token_env.description: Environment variable holding a read-only token. With a read token, reads use it and only writes use the token.

ssh_port.description: SSH port of a self-hosted forge when not 22; clone URLs become ssh://git@host:port/path.

token_cmd.description: Command whose stdout is the access token (the write token; it also reads when no read token is set). Secrets never live in the config file.

token_env.description: Environment variable holding the access token (the write token; it also reads when no read token is set). Agents ADE launches do not inherit it when a read token is set.

url.description: Web/API base URL; defaults to gitlab.com or github.com by kind.

forges.description: One entry per GitLab or GitHub host, keyed by a name manifests refer to.

editor.description: auto: code inside a VS Code terminal, else nvim, else $EDITOR. ade-nvim opens the Nix-wrapped Neovim; $EDITOR uses the environment.

layout.description: Default tab layout: code (editor main pane), agent (omp with the ADE implement skill) or manual (shell). Overrides the manifest workspace's layout; empty keeps it.

mode.description: Where workspaces open: zellij tabs, VS Code, or plain terminal supervision (auto detects).

external.description: Hands system-level events to a command of your own, e.g. to a CDE inbox. It never blocks the dashboard; failures are written to the audit log (notify.external).

command.description: Run with sh -c for each matching event. The event is JSON on stdin and ADE_EVENT_* variables (ID, KIND, SEVERITY, TITLE, PROJECT, SUBJECT, DETAIL, LINK, TIME). Empty turns the hook off.

dedupe.description: The same kind and severity in the same project is sent once per this window, also across ade processes (default 1h; 0 sends every event).

kinds.description: Event-kind globs the command receives (default budget.* and sync.stalled). Transient status events are never sent.

items.description: Event-kind globs the command receives (default budget.* and sync.stalled). Transient status events are never sent.

min_severity.description: Lowest severity sent: info, success, warn (default) or error.

timeout.description: Kills the command after this long (default 10s).

sync_stalled_after.description: How long a project's sync may keep failing before ADE raises sync.stalled, once per outage (default 2h; 0 never).

toast.description: Event-kind globs shown as pop-ups; every event is recorded in the inbox regardless.

items.description: Event-kind globs shown as pop-ups; every event is recorded in the inbox regardless.

source.description: Local path, https URL, or git+<url>#<path> of a *.ade.toml manifest.

audit_retain.description: "forever" (default) or a day count such as "365d": whole monthly audit files older than that are deleted; the current month never is.

dir.description: Where audit logs and work-item records live (default $XDG_DATA_HOME/ade). Keep it outside any git work tree.

feature_branches.description: ff-if-clean fast-forwards clean feature worktrees; notify-only only reports them.

interval.description: How often the dashboard updates in the background (default 10m).

on_start.description: Run a full update (git, then forge sync) at every start (default true).

handle.description: Your username on the forge; "mine" means assigned to or authored by this handle.

timezone.description: IANA time zone for standup and sprint boundaries.

workdays.description: Working days, lower-case three-letter names. Standup looks back to the previous working day.

items.description: Working days, lower-case three-letter names. Standup looks back to the previous working day.
